set_interruption_condition: set an interruption condition handler to check if the agent should stop early during execution
raise_if_should_stop: raise a ShouldStopException if the agent should stop based on the current interruption condition
ShouldStopException: catch the ShouldStopException to handle early termination of the agent when an interruption condition is triggered
InterruptCheck: define a callable that takes a post_pseudoorders boolean and returns whether the agent should stop
review_agent_interruption: review the agent interruption module to understand how early stopping conditions are managed for diplomacy agents
